item.title: EIU Student Senate receives budget proposals to be voted on at next meeting

item.description: As a tribute to the Winter Olympics, podcaster Emily Anderlik covers the Mario and Sonic Olympic games for Vancouver 2010 and the Sochi 2014.

item.title: Panthers of the Week: Zion Fruster, Genevieve Biberdorf
item.description: The male Panther of the Week is going to Zion Fruster from the men’s basketball team. item.title: EDITORIAL: The News wins 20 awards in state-wide contest
item.description: The Daily Eastern News staff won a combined 20 awards at the Illinois College Press Association conference Saturday in Chicago. The News won four first place awards, eight second place awards, two third place awards and six fourth place awards. item.description: Three OVC teams have two games left to decide the final two spots in the men’s basketball Ohio Valley Conference Championship. item.title: Eastern Illinois University on-campus enrollment drops 9.5% in spring
item.description: EIU’s on-campus enrollment dropped 9.5% this semester compared to last spring, with sharply falling international enrollment and a growing freshman class size highlighting the changes.
